title: Command skips stale readings when no rows have empty text
reasoning: The command advertises fetching readings that are missing or stale, but its gate only counts readings where text is exactly an empty string and returns immediately when that count is zero. In a database state with stale populated text and no empty text, neither the async nor synchronous refresh task can run, so stale readings remain unrefreshed despite the command contract.
recommendation: Either include the project's stale-text predicate in the initial count/early-return condition, or remove the stale behavior from the command contract if this command is only meant to process empty text values.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for this command, and the shown code has no coverage proving the stale-only case is intentional.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a management-command test with one stale reading whose text is non-empty and assert that the refresh task is invoked instead of returning early.
minimumFixScope: Update fetch_reading_texts.py so the preflight query and early return match the intended missing-or-stale behavior.
